**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 22 (Audit Rights) already reflects our preferred playbook position on all parameters:

| Parameter | Playbook preferred | Document (§ 22) |
|---|---|---|
| Frequency | Once per 12 months | Once in any twelve-month period ✓ |
| Notice | 30 days' written | Thirty days' prior written ✓ |
| Timing | Business hours | Normal business hours, no unreasonable disruption ✓ |
| Auditor | Independent, confidentiality-bound | Same, and off-site where practicable ✓ |
| Cost | Vendor unless underpayment >5% | Vendor unless underpayment >5% ✓ |
| System access | None | Vendor/auditor may not access Customer systems, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material or third-party confidential information ✓ |

Section 22.3 goes further in our favour (audit findings are our Confidential Information, use restricted to enforcement, copy of the final report, and payment of a shortfall closes out the audited quantity absent fraud or demonstrable error). A document-wide search for audit, inspection, verification, monitoring, remote access and telemetry language found no competing or broader right binding us, and § 23 (Records and Customer Assurance) contains only a heading with no substantive obligation.
